packageRules.description: openapi-ts packages move together and are the runtime contract (peer ranges, the patched helpers); review them as one PR
oasdiff is the breaking-change gate; MIN_OASDIFF_VERSION in codegen/breaking.ts must stay compatible
GitHub Actions bumps touch the same workflow files; one PR avoids serial rebases
runtime dependency bumps ship to users; group them but keep a human review

typescript is a runtime dependency, so its range must stay inside openapi-typescript's peer range (^5.x); TypeScript 7 also ships no JS compiler API. Hold until upstream widens the peer (see blocked-upstream issues)
